overview.text: Burton Brink is a retired sergeant with the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department. He chairs the board of Crime Survivors, Inc. He served on the 49th Assembly Central Committee. His campaign says he opposes SB 330 and other state mandates. His campaign lists public safety and fiscal responsibility as priorities. He has said the city should not accept the removal of 34 protected oak trees at Santa Anita Park for a temporary Olympic equestrian course without first exhausting every reasonable alternative. He has called for regular town halls and clear communication with residents. He served as an Arcadia city commissioner for eight years, including four as chairman.
